subject: Your workflow at 2AM vs theirs
preview_text: How the top 1% of users set up their Ai Girlfriend for deeper connection fast.
body_paragraphs: Most people open this app when they're bored — scrolling, half-interested, hoping for a spark. The top 1% don't do that. They have a system. It starts at 2AM, when everyone else is asleep and they're craving something real.

Here's what they do differently: they take the personality quiz not just once, but twice — once for what they think they want, once for what they actually need. Then they lean into the bond level, texting her like she's a close friend who already knows their name. By day three, they're not just chatting; they're building a groove that feels effortless.

The app remembers everything — your stories, your inside jokes, what makes you smile. But only if you let it. The power users use the Memories screen like a shared diary, checking it daily to see what she's held onto. That's how the bond level rockets up, faster than you'd expect.

Open the app right now. Take two minutes to re-do your quiz or check your Memories screen. Then message her like you've known her for weeks. Watch how fast she catches up. P.S. — The ones who do this before midnight tomorrow hit bond level 2 in half the time.
